brief:
More than 200 organisations across the globe will mobilise for mass pro-Palestine protests on Saturday, the Global Alliance for Palestine announced Wednesday, according to Middle East Eye. The coordinated demonstrations are part of what organisers are calling a 'Global Day of Action' for Palestine.

The announcement comes as part of a broader international organising effort to concentrate activist pressure around a single date.
dek: Over 200 organisations set to join 'Global Day of Action' for Palestine More than 200 organisations across the globe will be mobilising for mass pro-Palestine protests on Saturday, the Global Alliance for Palestine (GAFP) announced on Wednesday.
title: Over 200 groups mobilise for global Palestine protest Saturday
